Who has experienced this before? After a long period of staying awake (for whatever reason) you eventually need to sleep, but you've already gotten past the tiredness of yawning, and it actually becomes hard to fall to sleep. You'll be face down in a pillow and suddenly a voice will sound like it's being spoken in one ear, very closely. It can be quite frightening, and amusing at the same time. Sometimes it might be an odd noise like a train engine pumping away, or a short riff on an instrument.

Often, i've had my name called in very soothing voices, usually a womans. Other times i've had eery demonic sounding bursts of insults. The strangest thing i've heard was a parrot-ish voice saying "my cookie is crumbling" followed by a small sound not too different from the looney-toons intro. It's VERY strange, but funny when you recall it happening the next day.

I've experienced this alot, due to having CFS/ME, my sleep routine always gets knocked all over the place, and in an attempt to reset my body clock i have to deprive myself of sleep... which leads to me having these auditory hallucinations at least once a fortnight.
